fixes.title: Plaintext password in Redis payload (WOA→CIA chain)
fixes.summary: Root cause = same as P0-RAA-1 (cron_morning_briefing.py:169,302,304 built prompt strings containing the literal that got XADD'd to task_queue.payload.prompt / cia_task_queue.payload.prompt). All three sites now contain literal '<PG_PASSWORD>' placeholder; resolved by executor at runtime from .secrets/pg.env. Redis streams themselves (task_queue, cia_task_queue) may still contain historical XADD entries with the old literal — these need explicit XDEL / XTRIM, deferred to follow-up.
